item.subject: science
item.stem: During a school science exhibition in Jaipur, Meena displays four samples she collected at home: an Amoeba seen in pond water, bread mould grown on a stale roti, a culture of bacteria from curd, and a virus sample studied from a chart. Her teacher asks her to label each sample correctly. Which row of her chart is correct?

options.A: Amoeba – protozoan; bread mould – fungus; bacteria – bacterium; virus – multiplies only inside living cells
options.B: Amoeba – bacterium; bread mould – protozoan; bacteria – fungus; virus – an alga
options.C: Amoeba – protozoan; bread mould – bacterium; bacteria – fungus; virus – multiplies outside living cells
options.D: All four samples are bacteria because they are all microscopic
